title: Embeddings
summary: A learned lookup table turns each token into a vector of numbers; the same token always gets the same vector, wherever it stands.

title: Softmax
summary: Turns a list of scores into positive weights that sum to 1: softmax(s)_i = e^(s_i) / Σ_j e^(s_j), so bigger scores get bigger shares.

title: Dot product
summary: Multiply two vectors entry by entry and add up the products, a · b = Σ_i a_i b_i; it grows when the two point the same way.

title: Hidden state
summary: A recurrent model's fixed-size memory, rewritten at every step from the previous state and the current input: h_t = f(h_(t-1), x_t).

title: Cosine similarity
summary: The dot product of two vectors divided by both their lengths: the cosine of the angle between them, from -1 to 1; stretching either vector does not change it.

title: Cross-entropy
summary: The classification loss -log p, where p is the probability the model gave the correct answer (averaged over examples): near 0 when confident and right, large when the right answer got little probability.

title: Matrix shapes
summary: An (n × d) matrix times a (d × k) matrix gives an (n × k) matrix: the inner sizes must match, and each entry is the dot product of a row with a column.

title: Exponential decay
summary: Multiplying by the same factor a (0 < a < 1) at every step leaves a^t after t steps; a factor of e^(-k) per step leaves e^(-kt).

title: Big-O cost
summary: How work grows with input size n: O(n) doubles when n doubles, while comparing every item with every other is O(n²) and quadruples.

title: Convolution
summary: Slide one fixed set of weights (a kernel) along a sequence: each output is a weighted sum of nearby inputs, with the same weights at every position.
